scope.summary: Implement dynamic body wrinkle/fold maps (spec 13.22; PREQ-028, CC 4.2 one-wrinkle-for-all pattern): pose-driven tension/compression strain computed per region drives blend weights of authored wrinkle normal maps (neck folds, waist compression, knuckle stretch), riding the explicit driver graph so weights export via the MT-535 sidecar (GREQ-009 lineage).
acceptance_criteria: Wrinkle map system: tension/compression computed from pose (bone-driven region strain) drives blend weights of authored wrinkle normal maps; neck-fold, waist-compression, and knuckle-stretch regions ship seeded (PREQ-028).
Drivers ride the explicit corrective driver graph (pose channel to map weight, inspectable, disable-able) and export through the MT-535 driver sidecar so engines can rebuild the behavior (GREQ-009).
Weights ramp smoothly across the MT-532 QA pose sweep with no popping (bounded per-frame weight delta asserted).
Wrinkle maps compose with the layer stack and detail normals under the documented blend order without normal artifacts.
scope.risk_if_missed: Static skin under extreme poses breaks realism at necks and waists exactly in porn-range poses (deep arch, squat); CC 4.2 proved pose-driven wrinkle maps are the cheap fix, and omitting them leaves visible CGI tells at every fold (PREQ-028).

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
